name: Nishina Murasaki
source:
A new student to the high school, Murasaki’s innocence and beauty has quickly made her incredibly popular with the male students. Nonetheless, such attention is incredibly upsetting for her, as Murasaki is easily overwhelmed and frightened by the littlest things. In many ways, she like a little sister who needs regular guidance.

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20070211064424/http://www.elizar.com/?p=3]Nargrakhan's review[/url]]
